column1: # Tests that keep a generous limit and run in every validation: target, a tab, and why.

column2: Creates and boots a simulator of its own every run, about 140 seconds, because the shared pool cannot install the UI test runner with Xcode 27.
The orchestrator's tests that need a real Agent SDK or Codex host, a fake Claude or Codex or real processes: about 100 tests, about 60 seconds.

About 40 tests, each through a real Codex host and a fake Codex app-server, that wait on events with no per-test clock: about 25 seconds on an idle Mac, 80 under background QoS and up to 270 with other test runs on the Mac.

The SDK owners' tests on the Claude host model, with no network and no clock of their own, including property and ten-node matrices: about 60 seconds alone, 240 to 325 seconds in a full run on a busy Mac.

The server's tests on the host models render with the real screens: 87 to 93 seconds alone and 270 to 325 seconds in a full run on a busy Mac before the real-host tests left for daemon_server_host_test.

Every test starts a real fixture daemon and client process and waits on thousands of fsyncs of the action intent stores: about 60 to 80 seconds on an idle Mac and more than 300 seconds in a full run on a busy one.
